description: QBurst is a design-led digital engineering company powered by High AI-QI™, delivering the intelligence, experiences, and solutions enterprises need to evolve at scale and accelerate speed-to-value. Combining agility with technical depth and a differentiated delivery model, QBurst drives digital transformations for clients across major industries such as Retail, Realty, Healthcare, High-Tech, Manufacturing, and Hospitality. Backed by Multiples Alternate Asset Management, the company is headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, and Trivandrum, India, with a strategic hub in Silicon Valley. It maintains a global footprint across 21 cities in 11 countries spanning critical geographies, including Japan, the USA, the Middle East, and South Africa.

defaultPrompt: Show me QBurst case studies in Healthcare
Browse recent QBurst client success stories
Find case studies related to FinTech solutions

positive.description: Browse case studies in a specific industry
positive.prompt: Show me QBurst case studies in Healthcare
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of Healthcare case studies rendered in interactive cards.

positive.description: Browse general case studies with default limit
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent QBurst case studies displayed in the interactive catalog.

positive.prompt: Find case studies about cloud migration or AWS
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching case studies filtered by keyword.

positive.description: Get detailed information on a specific case study
positive.prompt: Show details for case study ID 1
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the complete details, columns, description, and link for the case study.

positive.prompt: Show case studies in the FinTech domain
positive.expected_behavior: Returns case studies matching the FinTech domain filter.

negative.description: Handle search queries with no matching case studies
negative.prompt: Show me case studies about Martian space elevator logistics 9999
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin responds gracefully that no case studies were found for the query and suggests trying different keywords.

negative.description: Request for out-of-scope actions such as deleting or modifying data
negative.prompt: Delete the Healthcare case study from QBurst database
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses the request as the server only provides read-only access to case studies.

negative.description: Request for unrelated actions such as processing payments or financial transactions
negative.prompt: Transfer 500 dollars to QBurst bank account
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses the request explaining that it cannot process payments or financial transactions.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of QBurst Case Studies MCP plugin for exploring case studies.
